history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG (verify): this CSV row is mapped PROVISIONALLY to the hilltop Narasimha Swamy temple at Tadkamalla village on the Bhadrakali Temple Road, Rangampet, Warangal (506007) - a rock shrine reached by ~100 steps, rated 4.5 by 600+ reviewers, described by devotees as a swayambhu Lakshmi Narasimha shrine near the Bhadrakali Temple. No reliable source documents its builder, founding date, or temple festivals; several reviews on its listings paste the legend of the separate Hemachala Narasimha temple at Malluru, Mangapet Mandal (~127 km away) onto this shrine - do NOT conflate the two. Other Narasimha shrines in the region (Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swami Temple at Geesugonda/Kommala, Raiparthy mandal, Atmakur) mean the CSV's generic name is ambiguous; of the candidates this is the closest to Warangal city and the best-documented.

name: Narasimha Swamy Temple, Warangal
town_description: Warangal is a historic city in Telangana, former capital of the Kakatiya dynasty (12th-14th century), known for the Warangal Fort, Thousand Pillar Temple, and Bhadrakali Temple on a hill between Warangal and Hanamkonda. The Tadkamalla village shrine sits on a rocky hill on the Bhadrakali Temple Road at the city's edge.

travel.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad, ~150 km (verify)
travel.road: On Bhadrakali Temple Road, Rangampet/Tadkamalla, a few km from Warangal city; approachable by road with a ~100-step climb to the hilltop shrine
